definitions.gloss: return gift; returning a courtesy; reciprocal gesture
definitions.explanation: Giving a gift or performing a courtesy in return for one received. An important part of Japanese gift-giving culture.

examples.japanese: {返礼|へんれい}の{品|しな}を{贈|おく}る。
お{歳暮|せいぼ}の{返礼|へんれい}に{何|なに}を{贈|おく}ろうか{悩|なや}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm trying to decide what to send as a return gift for the year-end present.

examples.japanese: ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}の{返礼|へんれい}{品|ひん}として{地元|じもと}の{特産物|とくさんぶつ}がもらえる。
examples.english: You can receive local specialty products as return gifts for hometown tax donations.

notes:
USAGE:
{返礼|へんれい} refers to the act of reciprocating a gift or courtesy. In Japanese culture, receiving a gift creates a social obligation to give something in return. The word is also widely used in the context of ふるさと{納税|のうぜい} (hometown tax), where municipalities send {返礼|へんれい}{品|ひん} (return gifts) to donors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {返礼|へんれい}{品|ひん}: return gift item
- {返礼|へんれい}の{品|しな}: gift given in return
- {返礼|へんれい}を{贈|おく}る: to send a return gift
- ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}の{返礼|へんれい}{品|ひん}: hometown tax return gift
